title: Changed-authority bind overhead decomposition
question: Which operations dominate the roughly fivefold cost increase of warm multi-key adaptive-provider binding relative to same-key local reuse?

workload.sequence: round robin over already initialized/warm authorities

components: exact hydraulic cache-key construction and fingerprinting
one-node default-MvG sampler-parameter initialization plus bind
intrinsic deep assignment of an already-built adaptive table
complete changed-authority warm provider bind from F-AHL33-compatible path
measurements: component fraction relative to complete changed-authority bind
support-point count and payload of copied tables
decision_rule: Characterization only. The next repair must target the largest avoidable component and must not introduce pointer/handle ownership semantics unless table-copy cost is shown to be material.
